ValidationRule.description: Prevents activating an Order with no related Contract, so fulfillment and billing always have a contractual basis to reference. Assumes "Activated" is one of the values configured on the Order.Status picklist in this org (the standard Order object ships editable Status values with no defaults - confirm the exact label used in Setup -> Object Manager -> Order -> Fields -> Status before deploying).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contract is required to activate an order.
